From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ross <emma@suncap.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@suncap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Suncap MAP kickstart: seed doc + week0 workshop

Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I promised a lightweight MAP seed that we can co-author to accelerate the eval and close timeline. Attached is a compact MAP seeding template (one page for goals, acceptance criteria, stakeholders, and a 30/60/90 close runway). I also created an editable Google Doc so we can capture stakeholder names and the preliminary acceptance tests: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1suncap-MAP-seed

Proposed next step: a 45-minute week0 workshop to align objectives, identify tech respondents, and agree on the acceptance matrix. Can you share two time options this week?

Quick notes on the seed:
- Week0 outcomes: tech contact identified, data access checklist, initial sample prompts for latency/quality checks.
- Acceptance criteria: basic inference accuracy, 95th pct latency under 450ms for 8k tokens, and a small throughput pilot.

Attachments: MAP_seeding_template.docx (docx, 1 page), Week0-workshop-slides.pptx (pptx, 6 slides)

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the seed and the Doc — this looks helpful. Rajiv and I reviewed and we have a couple quick asks before a workshop:

1) Compliance checkpoint — can you add a short SOC2 evidence checklist in the MAP? Our security team will need to verify data handling during the pilot.
2) Tech contact — this will be Rajiv (cc'ed). Can you give him edit access on the Doc and add a small section for sample data locations (S3 buckets, retention notes)?

We can do the 45-min workshop on Thursday 12/9 at 10:00 AM PT or Friday 12/10 at 9:00 AM PT. Either works for us.
